text: DSH Codex reasoning slider 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端的模型选择与推理强度界面插件。它在会话输入栏的模型槽位加入选择器，可切换模型，并以 Off、Low、High、Ultra 档位调整模型提供的推理等级；模型较多时可搜索，也会读取本地保存的自定义模型顺序。适合希望在会话中快速选择模型和推理强度的 DSH 用户。代码未声明额外 API 密钥或外部服务配置。

DSH Codex reasoning slider adds a model picker to the DeepSeek Harness web conversation bar. Switch models, search larger lists, and choose an available reasoning level: Off, Low, High, or Ultra. It can apply locally saved model ordering. No extra API key or external service is declared in the code.
想在对话输入栏直接切换模型和推理强度。
模型太多时，想在选择菜单里快速搜到需要的模型。
I want to adjust a model's reasoning effort right from the conversation bar.
DSH Codex reasoning slider 的功能「推理强度调节」：在会话输入栏打开选择器后，可用滑块选择模型提供的 Off、Low、High 或 Ultra 等级。
DSH Codex reasoning slider 的功能「模型搜索与切换」：在模型较多时，选择菜单显示搜索框；输入查询筛选模型，点选结果即可切换。

给 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器换成 Codex 桌面版风格的**推理强度滑块**。

> 这是从原版拆分出来的独立插件，只负责滑块本身。模型排序已拆成单独的插件
> [dsh-model-order-settings](https://github.com/kyf778/dsh-model-order-settings)。

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · 功能：- 把原生模型下拉换成 Codex 风格滑条（Off / Low / High / Ultra 四档）
- Ultra 档位的粒子动效
- 模型超过 4 个时自动出现搜索框
  - 搜的是**模糊子序列**，和官方 `/model` 选择器用的是同一个排序器（DSH `ui-primitives` 的
    `rankByName`）：输入 `ds` 就能找到 `Deepseek-V4.1-Flash`，前缀命中的排在前面
- 会读取 [dsh-model-order-settings](https://github.com/kyf778/dsh-model-order-settings) 保存的模型顺序
- **提供商分组标题会吸顶**：滚动时分组名固定在列表顶端并显示底色，下一个分组把它顶走；
  停在列表顶部时标题保持透明，不会无谓地挡内容（与原生 DSH 模型菜单的效果一致）
  - 吸顶底色是**完全不透明**的：官方那层 94% 不透明的分组底色下面垫了一层表面底色。
    直接用官方那 6% 的透明度时，从标题下滚过的行文字会隐约透上来，看着像叠字
  - 分组标题的颜色与字重**对齐原生菜单**（`label-tertiary` + 500）；原版用的是
    `label-secondary` + 400，比模型行自己的标签色还重一档，所以看着像"两套配色"

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · 来源与致谢：**本插件是衍生作品，基于 [Nachoneko_miao 的原版](https://github.com/bakabaicai/DSH-Codex-reasoning-effort-slider)（MIT）修改而来。**

约四分之三的 `client.js` 是原版的逐字代码（`Selector` 组件、指针与 canvas 逻辑、样式表都来自那边），所以按 MIT 许可证的要求：

- `LICENSE` 中保留了原版的版权声明
- `package.json` 的 `contributors` 列出了原作者
- 下方列明本插件相对原版做过的改动

本插件相对原版做过的改动：

- 拆成独立插件，只负责滑块本身（模型排序已分离为单独插件）
- 新增：读取并应用用户自定义的模型排序
- 新增：提供商分组标题吸顶（复用 DSH 官方 `ui-primitives` 的 `observeStickyMenuGroups`）
- 移除：弹窗右上角的重置按钮
@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · 来源与致谢：> 原版作者：Nachoneko_miao。如果喜欢，也请给[原仓库](https://github.com/bakabaicai/DSH-Codex-reasoning-effort-slider)点个 Star。

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · 独立性：本插件**可单独使用，不依赖**模型排序插件：

- 装了排序插件：按你保存的顺序显示模型
- 没装：按模型目录的默认顺序显示，功能完全正常

两个插件通过同一个 `localStorage` 键（`dsh-codex-slider-model-order-v1`）和一个
`dsh-model-order-changed` 窗口事件通信，因此排序改动会立即反映到这里。

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · 安装：在 Harness 里点 **插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴本仓库地址即可。或：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kyf778/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider
```

装好后点会话输入栏下方的模型名称，展开看到滑条即为成功。

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · DSH Codex reasoning slider：**English** | [简体中文](./README.md)

A Codex-style **reasoning-effort slider** that replaces the model picker in DeepSeek Harness.

> Split out of the original project as a standalone plugin that handles the slider only.
> Model ordering now lives in its own plugin,
> [dsh-model-order-settings](https://github.com/kyf778/dsh-model-order-settings).

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · Features：- Replaces the plain model dropdown with a Codex-style slider (Off / Low / High / Ultra)
- Particle animation on the Ultra level
- A search box appears automatically when there are more than 4 models
  - it searches by **fuzzy subsequence**, through the same ranker DSH's own `/model`
    picker uses (`rankByName` from `ui-primitives`): typing `ds` finds
    `Deepseek-V4.1-Flash`, and prefix hits rank first
- Reads the model order saved by [dsh-model-order-settings](https://github.com/kyf778/dsh-model-order-settings)
- **Sticky provider headings**: while you scroll, the provider name pins to the top of the
  list with a solid fill, and the next provider pushes it away. At the top of the list the
  heading stays transparent, so it never covers content for no reason — the same behaviour
  as DSH's own model menu
  - the pinned fill is **fully opaque**: an opaque surface colour sits beneath the theme's
    94%-opaque group-header fill. Using that 6% translucency alone let the glyphs of the row
    scrolling underneath bleed through the pinned label, which read as overlapping text

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · Credits and attribution：- split into a standalone plugin that handles the slider only (model ordering moved to its own plugin)
- added: reads and applies the user's saved model order
- added: sticky provider group headings (reuses DSH's own `observeStickyMenuGroups` from `ui-primitives`)
- removed: the reset-to-default button in the popup's top-right corner

> Original author: Nachoneko_miao. If you like it, please also star the

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · Standalone：This plugin **works on its own and does not depend on** the model-ordering plugin:

- Ordering plugin installed: models appear in the order you saved
- Not installed: models appear in the catalog's default order, and everything still works

The two plugins communicate through one `localStorage` key
(`dsh-codex-slider-model-order-v1`) and a `dsh-model-order-changed` window event,
so an order change shows up here immediately.

@local/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider README · Install：In Harness, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and paste this repository's URL. Or:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kyf778/dsh-codex-reasoning-slider
```

Then click the model name below the composer input; if the slider expands, it worked.
